title: UUIDv8 (custom/experimental)
summary: UUID version 8 reserves the version and variant bits but leaves all other bits free for application-defined data. Use it for custom, time-ordered, or domain-specific 128-bit ids that still want UUID shape.

notes: No standardized time or node semantics; the application chooses.
Useful for migrating proprietary 128-bit ids into UUID-shaped values.
